description: FutureMe contains the monthly setup flow.
Monthly setup captures fixed commitments.
Fixed commitments feed the scheduling engine as anchors.
Capacity changes routine frequency and schedule pressure.
Capacity affects recommendations and whether the plan should soften.
Generated schedule produces tasks that may become active.
Rules engine constrains where tasks can be placed.
Completion system marks tasks as completed.
Completion state tells What’s Next which tasks no longer need attention.
What’s Next decides which task currently needs attention.
What’s Next identifies upcoming tasks.
What’s Next classifies missed or overdue tasks.
What’s Next powers the daily dashboard.
What’s Next may trigger optional notification nudges.
Notification nudges use Web Push delivery when enabled.
Push notifications require the service worker.
Push subscriptions are stored in Supabase.
Scheduled reminders are stored in Supabase.
Due scheduled reminders may create notification nudges.
Notifications do not control app state or completion state.
The daily dashboard is the primary user experience.
Night shift suggests the next focused loop.
Night shift reviews whether What’s Next logic is clear.
Night shift checks that notifications support the plan rather than drive it.
Loop engineering improves FutureMe through focused cycles.
